title: Putting a parcel in the van
passage:
If the van is still here, could you put this parcel in it?
A. I’m afraid it pulled out ten minutes ago.
B. The box weighs just under ten kilos.
C. I can unlock the side door from here.
passageZh:
如果貨車還在這裡，可以幫我把這件包裹放上去嗎？
A. 不好意思，它十分鐘前就開走了。
B. 這箱不到十公斤。
C. 我可以從這裡打開側門。
